summary: Retest of iteration-1 fixes. All 5 requested items work. Doc templates: on a fresh account I edited template tpl-checklist-buka to 'TEST_Judul Edit', deleted tpl-checklist-tutup, synced, logged out and back in (same browser context and a NEW browser context). The edited title was kept and the deleted template stayed deleted, both in the UI and in /api/sync/pull. Demo flag: after loading demo + sync, a new browser context shows demo-banner and demo-clear-button (demo-load-button hidden). Clear + sync left 0 live is_demo records on the server and the banner went away. Rate limit: 11 logins with different X-Forwarded-For values returned no 429; the same XFF gets 429 on the 11th attempt. UI fixes: pos-clear-cart is 82x44, the 'Opname' label is not truncated (scrollWidth == clientWidth), HPP margin 100/150/-5 hides all results and shows an error, and the toast now sits at the bottom (y=543 of 667, pointerEvents none). Regression: demo login, dashboard KPIs (all 8 plus the chart) and POS checkout (receipt TRX-261118-001609) all work. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed (15 regression + 4 new).

minor.issue: The bucket key is the FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Ingress passes it through: rotating XFF values gave separate buckets in the test. So an attacker can skip login brute-force protection by sending a random XFF header. Use the right-most XFF entry (the one ingress appends) or X-Real-IP set by ingress, and add a per-email bucket.

issues: Stock action buttons stock-in-button / stock-out-button / stock-adjust-button are 36px tall (size=sm), below the 44px minimum touch target
Long business name is cut with an ellipsis in the header ('Toko Demo USAH...') because of the sync pill. Acceptable, but consider wrapping or a smaller font
The toast at bottom: insets.bottom+80 sits over the cart bar/pos-clear-cart area on POS. It does not block taps (pointerEvents none) but covers the cart total for a moment

action_items: MEDIUM (security): In rate_limit, stop trusting the client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For entry. Use the right-most/ingress-set IP and also limit per email for login.
LOW: Make the product detail stock buttons (Masuk/Keluar/Opname) at least 44px tall.
LOW (carry-over): flush the outbox on web pagehide/visibilitychange; paginate /api/sync/pull (to_list(20000)); replace @app.on_event with lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: store.ts:76-81 seeds templates locally with updated_at=2000-01-01 and does not queue them. Server edits/deletes are applied by applyRemote, which is correct. A deleted template is seeded again locally before the pull, so it shows briefly when offline on a new device until the first pull. This is acceptable.
selectors.ts:108 hasDemo checks products/sales/customers/finance/invoices/bills only. purchases and suppliers are not checked, but this is fine because demo always creates products.
